name: ecommerce-reviews-and-ratings-filament
description: The staff moderation surface for reviews and ratings: the decision queue, the flag queue, merchant replies and the coverage of the published aggregate.
features: A moderation queue filtered by derived display state, urgent screening first
Edited-after-approval flagged on every row a moderator sees
Moderation decisions taken from closed enums with no free text anywhere
A reader flag queue that never shows who reported what
Merchant replies written through the domain, refused when screening is unbound
Read-only expression detail carrying the whole moderation history
A coverage widget naming the displayed and recorded populations apart
Verified, unverified and unknown kept apart all the way to the badge
No author reference or display name is searchable or filterable
Every unpublished resource and relation-manager ability refused by name
